### 研究结论

跨 **14 条预注册配置**（历史四阶段 B/C/D/E1、两条时序 track B/C、首条 confirmatory 样本外运行），没有任何 treatment 臂相对 price-only 基线显示可靠的正向增量 rank-IC。**所有置信区间都跨越零。**

### 贡献

诚实、预注册的贡献是 **null 点估计**、**端到端反泄漏纪律**、与 **power-limit 披露**——而非已宣告的等价。前瞻 power 分析显示，冻结的 60/90/120 月 Jennison–Turnbull 日程在文献记录的月频 rank-IC 噪声地板 $\sigma \approx 0.10$ 下**结构性欠功率**（宣告等价约需 36+ 年）。

## English

::: {.callout-note title="Read this first"}
**Null is the intended, publishable outcome.** Aionis is not a trading bot or a
cognitive system — it is a disciplined experiment harness: one pre-registered,
two-tailed claim per phase on the cross-sectional monthly rank-IC of S&P 500
point-in-time constituents (and CSI 300 in Track C).

### Research verdict

Across **14 pre-registered configurations** spanning four historical phases
(B/C/D/E1), two chronological tracks (B, C), and the first **confirmatory**
out-of-sample run, no treatment arm shows a reliable positive incremental rank-IC
over the price-only baseline. **All confidence intervals bracket zero.**

### Contribution

The honest, pre-registered contribution is the **null point estimate**, the
**end-to-end anti-leakage discipline**, and the **power-limit disclosure** — not a
declared equivalence. A prospective power analysis shows the frozen
60/90/120-month Jennison–Turnbull schedule is **structurally underpowered** for
SESOI $\pm 0.010$ at the documented monthly rank-IC noise floor
$\sigma \approx 0.10$ (declaring equivalence would need ~36+ years).
